DIVIDEND DISTRIBUTION POLICY: The objective of the Dividend Distribution Policy is to ensure right balance between the quantum of dividend paid and amount of profits to be retained in the business for various purposes.

Towards this objective, the following key parameters are considered for declaration of dividend: (i) Internal Factors (Financial Parameters): ► Net Operating Profit after Tax; ► Working Capital Requirements; ► Capital Expenditure Requirements; ► Cash required to meet contingencies; ► Outstanding Borrowings; and ► Past Dividend Trends.
